blocks.en: Let $X,Y$ be Banach spaces. Let $T_n\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$, $n\in\mathbb{N}$, be such that $\|T_nx\|$ is bounded uniformly in $n$ for each fixed $x\in X$. Then $\|T_n\|$ is bounded uniformly in $n$.
blocks.zh: 设 $X,Y$ 为 Banach 空间. 设 $T_n\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$, $n\in\mathbb{N}$, 满足对每个固定的 $x\in X$, $\|T_nx\|$ 关于 $n$ 一致有界. 那么 $\|T_n\|$ 关于 $n$ 一致有界.
blocks.label: thm:uniform-boundedness

blocks.en: Let $Z$ be a Banach space and let $x_n$ be a sequence in $Z$ such that $f(x_n)$ is bounded uniformly in $n$ for every $f\in Z^*$. Then $\|x_n\|$ is bounded uniformly in $n$.
blocks.zh: 设 $Z$ 为 Banach 空间, $x_n$ 为 $Z$ 中的序列, 且对每个 $f\in Z^*$, $f(x_n)$ 关于 $n$ 一致有界. 那么 $\|x_n\|$ 关于 $n$ 一致有界.
blocks.label: cor:weakly-bounded-sequence-norm-bound

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The proof of the corollary is obtained by setting $X=Z^*$ and $Y=\mathbb{R}$ ($\mathbb{C}$) in Theorem~\ref{thm:uniform-boundedness}.
blocks.zh: 在 Theorem~\ref{thm:uniform-boundedness} 中令 $X=Z^*$ 且 $Y=\mathbb{R}$ ($\mathbb{C}$), 就得到这一推论的证明.

blocks.en: Let $X,Y$ be Banach spaces and let $T_n\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ be such that $f(T_nx)$ is bounded uniformly in $n$ for each $f\in Y^*$ and $x\in X$. Then $\|T_n\|$ is bounded uniformly in $n$.
blocks.zh: 设 $X,Y$ 为 Banach 空间, $T_n\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ 满足对每个 $f\in Y^*$ 及 $x\in X$, $f(T_nx)$ 关于 $n$ 一致有界. 那么 $\|T_n\|$ 关于 $n$ 一致有界.
blocks.label: cor:weak-operator-bounds-imply-uniform-bound

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: For the proof, apply first Corollary~\ref{cor:weakly-bounded-sequence-norm-bound} to find that $\|T_nx\|$ is bounded uniformly in $n$ and then use Theorem~\ref{thm:uniform-boundedness}.
blocks.zh: 证明时, 先应用 Corollary~\ref{cor:weakly-bounded-sequence-norm-bound}, 得到 $\|T_nx\|$ 关于 $n$ 一致有界, 再使用 Theorem~\ref{thm:uniform-boundedness}.
